verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no API for creating products or prices. Kushki's Smartlink is described only as a way to create and customize payment links, with no evidence it can be provisioned programmatically. Nothing shows an agent creating a product, price, and payment link via the API in one session, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent provision a new product, price, and payment link via the API in a single session
